title: jacobaea vulgaris var. dunensis
intro: Jacobaea vulgaris var. dunensis, commonly known as Dun's Ragwort or Lesser Ragwort, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Jacobaea vulgaris var. dunensis include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, while its therapeutic actions include relaxing spasms and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as jacaranone and jacolin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
